parameters.text:
=Process these testimonials and reviews for use in marketing.

Reviews found online:
{{ $('Fetch New Reviews G2').item.json.choices[0].message.content }}

Raw testimonials from sheet:
{{ JSON.stringify($('Fetch Testimonials Sheet').all().slice(-10).map(i=>i.json)) }}

For each usable testimonial:
1. Extract the core quote (clean up grammar if needed, keep meaning intact)
2. Identify the use case it proves
3. Suggest where to use it (landing page/case study/ad/LinkedIn)

Return JSON:
{
  "testimonials": [{
    "original": "",
    "polished_quote": "",
    "customer": "",
    "use_case_proven": "",
    "best_used_on": "",
    "star_rating": 0
  }],
  "top_quote": "single best quote for homepage",
  "themes": ["what customers consistently praise"],
  "gaps": ["what use cases have no testimonials yet"]
}

=⭐ *Social Proof Weekly Update*

*{{ $json.testimonials.length }} usable testimonials this week*

*Top Quote:*
"{{ $json.top_quote }}"

*Customers consistently praise:*
{{ $json.themes.map(t=>`• ${t}`).join('\n') }}

*Missing testimonials for:*
{{ $json.gaps.map(g=>`• ${g}`).join('\n') }}

parameters.content:
## Social Proof Aggregator
Runs weekly Monday 8 AM.
Searches G2/Capterra/Trustpilot for new reviews.
Fetches raw testimonials from Google Sheets.
GPT-4o polishes quotes and maps to use cases.
Identifies gaps — which benefits have no proof yet.
Saves to Notion library + Slack digest.
